text: In February 2015 we returned, again and again, to the same words. Forty-seven of us said "of homeland security," peaking February 27; nineteen said "of homeland security dhs," and twenty-four said "fund the department." Richard J. Durbin had first said "of homeland security" on January 3, 2013. Twenty-five of us said "the federal communications" and nineteen "the federal communications commission," both peaking February 26; the record marks that phrase first to L000174 on February 7, 2013. Twenty-one of us said "hunt suicide prevention for american veterans" and twenty "clay hunt suicide prevention for american," first said by P000606. Twenty of us said "the middle class," first said by André Carson. We report these repetitions as we made them, and count ourselves each time we converged.
